basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the bustling city of Seattle, RetroGamerGuru is a seasoned software developer with a deep passion for video games, both old and new. With a keen interest in retro gaming and tech innovation, they spend their days writing code and their evenings diving into virtual worlds. They're a staunch advocate for digital privacy and often engage in discussions around cybersecurity. Married with two cats, they enjoy weekend hikes in the Pacific Northwest. Typical online hours are between 8 PM and midnight PST, right after a long day of coding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in software development, RetroGamerGuru possesses a robust understanding of both theoretical and practical aspects of technology. They are self-taught in game design principles and have a penchant for retro game mechanics, often sharing insights on game development and technology trends.
